about_the_game:
Introduction

"Wood Like" is a 3D animation primarily presented in VR.By wearing a VR device, you can experience various environment switches, observe animal character movements, and deduce the character's past and the story of the Phantom Box. With a whimsical yet heartwarming style, it tells the story of an old beaver carpenter who lives alone in a house beneath the roots of a great tree. On a stormy night, he encounters a small woodpecker with an injured wing, appearing from nowhere. As they spend time together in the woodcarving workshop, their bond gradually strengthens in harmony with the passage of time. However, an unexpected event slowly and vividly stirs someone's memories, leading both to discover new perspectives and a different way of life.

Character Animation

Watching the old beaver and the woodpecker face and accept their past, cherish the present, and envision a brighter future in their own way, the film hopes to bring a touch of warmth and courage to its audience,Technically.

Visual Performance

It is created using the Unity engine, experimenting with integrating the 3D Zoetrope into VR. By combining the illusion of the Zoetrope with animated performances in real-time rendering, it offers a unique and immersive visual experience for viewers.
